_about: Accepted player photos (orchestrator-curated), regenerated by the photo pipeline. Each: Wikimedia Commons file, licence (allowed: CC0, Public domain, CC BY n [jurisdiction], CC BY-SA n [jurisdiction], Attribution), licence URL (empty for public domain), photographer (artist), Commons page (source), original thumbnail size [w, h], and the largest Vision face box [x, y, w, h] normalised with origin at the bottom-left, clamped to the image (Vision reports boxes that run past the edge for faces near it). Auto-accepted only when the largest face is >= 1.5% of the image and >= 2x any other face; entries in curated/photo-exclusions.json are removed after visual review. Originals live in .cache/sources/photos/orig/{player}.{ext} (not committed).
